status_legend.in_progress: The one feature currently being worked on. Only one feature can be in progress at a time.
status_legend.blocked: Can't proceed due to a documented issue.
status_legend.passing: Verification passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Web Design
features.user_visible_behavior: Users get a light landing page prototype with a hero, three-slide feature preview, and clear creation entries for comic drama and MV workflows.

features.title: Workflow Canvas Foundation
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can work on a Figma-like white canvas with nodes, edges, drag, free-percentage zoom, selection, a single bottom add entry with explicit input/output node flow labels, and restorable layout state.

features.title: Script Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can use AI modify conversation mode, then Generate an editable direct-text Script outcome node on the canvas with backend-confirmed provider/model evidence, visible loading animation, simplified node cards, and only configured live provider paths.

features.title: Storyboard Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can convert script output into an editable shot list with scene, character, action, dialogue, camera, duration, and prompt fields.

features.title: Image Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can use one self-contained Image node for generated images: connected text, prompt-only generation, upload, and image-plus-prompt edit all update the selected Image node itself, with the model selector showing SeedDream 5.0.

features.title: Scene Image Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can generate scene or background images from storyboard scene descriptions and receive reusable scene asset references.

features.title: Image Composition Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can combine character assets, scene assets, and shot data into a composed shot image or keyframe.

features.title: Audio Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can generate or upload playable audio directly on the Audio node through the local MiniMax backend path; connected text can seed lyrics, generated audio renders as playable native controls with local download on the source Audio node, and existing audio can be edited through MiniMax cover generation from the inline AI box.

features.title: Video Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can generate one video outcome from a Video node prompt and duration, with connected script/image/reference-video/audio outputs feeding local FastAPI Ark Seedance generation; playable URL responses render as draggable video nodes, while task-id-only responses are labeled honestly because provider polling remains later scope.

features.title: Export Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can assemble selected clips, audio, and export settings into a final comic drama, MV, or short-form video artifact.

features.title: Minimal Task Status And Retry
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can see generation task status, recover from failures, retry failed work, and look up generated results consistently across AI nodes.

features.title: Asset Library MVP
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can browse, inspect, select, and reuse generated character, scene, image, audio, video, and export assets.

features.title: Generation History And Version Timeline
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can review generation attempts, prompt/model metadata, asset versions, selected outputs, and recoverable timeline events.

features.title: 9-Grid Storyboard Node
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can generate a 9-grid storyboard from selected shots, compositions, or keyframes.

features.title: Production Auth And Workspace Management
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can log in, select a workspace, and access projects, assets, tasks, and history through production account and role boundaries.

features.title: Agent Runtime Foundation
features.user_visible_behavior: Existing text, image, audio, and video node generation keeps the same API behavior while backend agent execution is organized behind reusable task profiles, prompt compilation, memory-selection contracts, and node handlers.
